## About
I&C Auto Transmission Repair is a car repair shop on Washington Blvd in Montebello. Transmissions are in the name, and the shop handles other repairs too.
Joe and Kenny own the place. One reviewer says they answer your questions and tell you what to watch for with your car. Another says their family has been coming here for generations.
The shop is rated 4.8 on Google from 55 reviews.

## Services
- Transmission work: One customer had their transmission rebuilt here and came back a year later for service. All looked good.
- Transmission oil change: Fresh transmission fluid to keep things shifting right.
- Other repairs: Not just transmissions. The shop takes on other repairs as well.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours on Saturday?
A: Saturday we're open from 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM.

Q: Do you only work on transmissions?
A: No. Transmissions are our specialty, but we do other repairs too.

A: 700 Washington Blvd, Montebello, CA 90640.
